title: AIOS module catalog
description: Composable Terraform modules for StackGen AIOS; consumed by docs module catalog page.

modules.name: Foundation
modules.desc: LLM vault secrets, model providers, and named model instances. Base module every other AIOS module depends on.

modules.name: Foundation (Bedrock)
modules.desc: Amazon Bedrock model provider and Claude Sonnet 4.6 via cross-region inference profile. IAM role or static AWS keys. Wire model_names to agents instead of direct Anthropic API keys.

modules.name: Policies
modules.desc: Central library of 12+ reusable OPA/Rego guardrail policies for agent governance. Each policy can be individually toggled.

modules.name: CCE Scripts (shared)
modules.desc: Bash pack for Code Context Engine (CCE) scans on Ubuntu sidecars: cce plan, cce run -recipes, PR delta, lens download. Embedded by agent modules at tofu apply via CCE_PACK_B64 — not typically called directly from customer roots.
modules.usage:
# Embedded by agent modules (e.g. monorepo-services-splitter, terraform-bot).
# After script changes, bump cce_pack_version in pack.tf and re-apply parent agent module.

modules.name: Remote Runner
modules.desc: Register or look up sg_remote_runner for aiden-runner (outbound-only to mothership). Exposes cli_start_command and helm_install_command. Agent modules pass runner_name and remote_runner_attach_to_agent.

modules.name: AWS Integration
modules.desc: AWS integration with IAM role assumption via Vault. Containerized AWS CLI MCP integration.

modules.name: Azure Integration
modules.desc: Azure service principal with Reader role, credentials stored in Vault, and containerized Azure CLI MCP integration.
modules.usage:
module "azure_integration" {
  source = "github.com/appcd-dev/solutions//modules/aios-integration-azure?ref=main"

  azure_subscription_id = var.azure_subscription_id
  azure_tenant_id       = var.azure_tenant_id
  azure_client_id       = var.azure_client_id
  azure_client_secret   = var.azure_client_secret
}

modules.name: GCP Integration
modules.desc: Vault secret with GCP service account credentials and a containerized GCP MCP integration.

modules.name: GitHub Integration
modules.desc: GitHub SCM integration for repository operations, PRs, and code analysis.

modules.name: Grafana Integration
modules.desc: Grafana observability integration with API token stored in Vault.

modules.name: Datadog Integration
modules.desc: Datadog observability integration using the official Datadog MCP server; API and app keys stored in Vault.

modules.name: PagerDuty Integration
modules.desc: PagerDuty incident-management integration with REST API token stored in Vault.

modules.name: FireHydrant Integration
modules.desc: FireHydrant incident management integration with API token and optional API base URL stored in Vault.

modules.name: Internal Tooling (REST API)
modules.desc: Generic internal REST API integration for PrivateSaaS operator consoles and service catalogs (Guild type restapi).

modules.name: ServiceNow Integration
modules.desc: ServiceNow ITSM integration with instance URL and basic-auth credentials stored in Vault.

modules.name: Confluence Integration
modules.desc: Confluence knowledge-base integration for operational runbooks and postmortem templates.

modules.name: Palo Alto Integration
modules.desc: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS firewall integration with management URL and XML API key stored in Vault.

modules.name: GitLab Integration
modules.desc: GitLab SCM integration with instance URL and API token stored in Vault.

modules.name: Argo CD Integration
modules.desc: Argo CD GitOps integration for application health and sync inspection.

modules.name: SonarQube Integration
modules.desc: SonarQube integration for quality gates and branch analysis.

modules.name: Langfuse Integration
modules.desc: Langfuse LLM observability: traces, cost, and quality scoring. API keys in Vault; containerized Guild integration sidecar.

modules.name: Slack Integration
modules.desc: Slack ChatOps integration for incident channels, approvals, and notifications.

modules.name: ClickHouse Integration
modules.desc: ClickHouse analytics integration using the Bring Your Own Image (BYOI) pattern.

modules.name: Cursor Integration
modules.desc: Cursor AI code editor integration for pair-programming agents.

modules.name: Linear Integration
modules.desc: Linear project management integration via OAuth. Connects to mcp.linear.app — no container image needed.

modules.name: Ubuntu CLI Integration
modules.desc: Generic Ubuntu MCP shell for OS-level diagnostics (curl, ping, dig, journalctl, top, df). No vault secret needed.

modules.name: SRE Agents
modules.desc: Production-ready SRE team: triage, change correlation, auto-remediation, risk assessment, and incident command. 5 agents, 9 runbooks, 8 remediation patterns, 4 evidence checklists, 2 workflows.

modules.name: Grafana Alert Triage
modules.desc: Grafana alert RCA with webhook ingest, Rego filter, prior-incident memory, CCE incident-scoping on service repos (file:line), ReAcTree hypothesis investigation, optional k8s enrichment, and Slack RCA publish.

modules.name: AWS SRE
modules.desc: AWS cloud operations SRE with K8s diagnostics, security audit, cost analysis, and tagging compliance. 1 agent, 4 runbooks, 2 workflows.

modules.name: GCP SRE
modules.desc: GCP operations SRE with GKE diagnostics, Cloud SQL health, security audit, and cost analysis. 1 agent, 4 runbooks, 2 workflows.

modules.name: Azure DevOps SRE
modules.desc: Azure data pipeline SRE with ClickHouse diagnostics, storage queue inspection, and function health checks. Guild `sg_evidence_checklist` + auto-approved remediation patterns on the triage workflow.

modules.name: Azure SaaS SRE
modules.desc: Single-tenant Azure SaaS SRE with PagerDuty webhook ingest, deterministic alert filtering, Datadog+Azure auto-investigation, Confluence runbook lookup, and Azure Automation remediation. 3 agents, 1 workflow, optional sg_webhook.

modules.name: PrivateSaaS DevOps/SRE
modules.desc: PrivateSaaS DevOps/SRE with Grafana webhook ingest, deterministic alert filtering, Grafana/AWS/PAN-OS investigation, bounded AWS remediation, and read-only connectivity audit. 3 agents, 2 workflows, optional sg_webhook.
modules.usage:
module "privatesaas_devops_sre" {
  source = "github.com/appcd-dev/solutions//modules/aios-agent-privatesaas-devops-sre?ref=main"

  model_names = module.foundation.model_names
  policy_ids = {
    dangerous_ops   = module.policies.policy_ids.dangerous_ops
    sre_remediation = module.policies.policy_ids.sre_remediation
    prod_write_gate = module.policies.policy_ids.prod_write_gate
  }

  grafana_server = "https://grafana.internal.example.com"
  grafana_token  = var.grafana_token
  aws_secret_id  = module.aws_integration.secret_id
  paloalto_management_url = "https://fw-mgmt.internal.example.com"
  paloalto_api_key        = var.paloalto_api_key
}

modules.name: PrivateSaaS SRE (Aiden for SRE)
modules.desc: PrivateSaaS SRE with FireHydrant + Grafana ingest, GCP and internal tooling investigation, multi-source runbook coordinator, RCA synthesis, and document-only prod recommendations. Bifrost LLM via foundation; optional Grafana/FireHydrant webhooks.
modules.usage:
module "privatesaas_sre" {
  source = "github.com/appcd-dev/solutions//modules/aios-agent-privatesaas-sre?ref=main"

  model_names = [module.foundation.model_names_by_provider.bifrost]
  policy_ids = {
    dangerous_ops   = module.policies.policy_ids.dangerous_ops
    sre_remediation = module.policies.policy_ids.sre_remediation
  }

  grafana_server         = "https://grafana.internal.example.com"
  grafana_token          = var.grafana_token
  gcp_credentials_json   = var.gcp_credentials_json
  gcp_project_id         = var.gcp_project_id
  firehydrant_api_key    = var.firehydrant_api_key
  internal_tool_base_url = "https://console.internal.example.com/api/v1"
}

modules.name: PrivateSaaS GitOps SRE
modules.desc: Slack /aiden GitOps SRE with CCE gitops-scope: map code blast radius to Argo CD apps for scoped rollback recommendations.

modules.name: Self-Hosted Infra
modules.desc: Aiden for Infra — CloudFormation stack failure ingest + filter, AWS/CFN read-only investigation, HITL-gated change-set recommendations, drift audit, and pre-deploy review for self-hosted private AWS. 3 agents, 3 workflows, optional sg_webhook, Ubuntu CLI, remote runner, and evidence checklist.

modules.name: CloudFormation Author
modules.desc: Aiden for CloudFormation — five governance pillars (remote orchestration, FedRAMP/baseline compliance, hardened synthesis, governed deployment, continuous drift). Workflows: intent-to-infrastructure, cloudformation-drift-management, cfn-contextual-compliance, cfn-governed-deployment. Triggers: Guild chat, intent/compliance/drift webhooks, optional drift cron. Bedrock Sonnet 4.6 only. See docs/cfn-author.md for sample payloads.
modules.usage:
module "cfn_author" {
  source = "github.com/appcd-dev/solutions//modules/aios-agent-cfn-author?ref=main"

  model_names = module.foundation_bedrock.model_names
  policy_ids = {
    dangerous_ops   = module.policies.policy_ids.dangerous_ops
    prod_write_gate = module.policies.policy_ids.prod_write_gate
  }

  target_repository_full_name = "org/infra-templates"
  fedramp_profile             = "moderate"
  org_baseline_name           = "acme-prod-baseline-v2"
  github_secret_id            = module.github_integration.secret_id
  aws_secret_id               = module.aws_integration.secret_id

  enable_intent_webhook     = true
  enable_compliance_webhook = true
  enable_drift_webhook        = true
  enable_drift_schedule       = true
  webhook_trigger_base_url    = var.stackgen_url
  webhook_trigger_org_id      = var.stackgen_project_id

  # Trigger examples: docs/cfn-author.md
}

modules.name: CFN Governance Runbooks
modules.desc: Reusable Guild runbook SOP pack for CloudFormation governance pillars: remote orchestration, contextual compliance (FedRAMP + org baseline), hardened synthesis, governed deployment, continuous governance. Nested by aios-agent-cfn-author; usable standalone for custom workflow wiring. Trigger docs: docs/cfn-author.md.

modules.name: Aiden Infra (composition)
modules.desc: Thin TR-facing entry: nests aios-agent-cfn-author + optional aios-agent-terraform-bot. Single tofu apply for dual IaC (CFN intent/drift + TF module quality). No second StackGen MCP. See docs/tr-deployment-profile.md.

modules.name: SRE Ticket Resolution
modules.desc: ServiceNow ticket resolution with webhook ingest, deterministic ticket filtering, Grafana/Prometheus + AWS investigation, bounded AWS remediation, and Slack notification. 3 agents, 1 workflow, optional sg_webhook.
modules.usage:
module "sre_ticket_resolution" {
  source = "github.com/appcd-dev/solutions//modules/aios-agent-sre-ticket-resolution?ref=main"

  model_names = module.foundation.model_names
  policy_ids = {
    dangerous_ops   = module.policies.policy_ids.dangerous_ops
    sre_remediation = module.policies.policy_ids.sre_remediation
  }

  servicenow_instance_url = var.servicenow_instance_url
  servicenow_username     = var.servicenow_username
  servicenow_password     = var.servicenow_password
  grafana_server          = var.grafana_server
  grafana_token           = var.grafana_token
  aws_secret_id           = module.aws_integration.secret_id
  slack_bot_token           = var.slack_bot_token
}

modules.name: Multi-Tenant SRE RCA
modules.desc: Multi-tenant SaaS SRE RCA with Datadog webhook ingest, deterministic alert filtering (priority/tenant allowlist), cross-signal investigation (Datadog/GCP Cloud Logging/AWS ECS+CloudTrail/GitHub), Slack RCA publish, and Slack thread collaboration workflow. 4 agents, 2 workflows, optional sg_evidence_checklist and sg_webhooks.
modules.usage:
module "multitenant_sre_rca" {
  source = "github.com/appcd-dev/solutions//modules/aios-agent-multitenant-sre-rca?ref=main"

  model_names = module.foundation.model_names
  policy_ids = {
    dangerous_ops = module.policies.policy_ids.dangerous_ops
    data_risk_pii = module.policies.policy_ids.data_risk_pii
  }

  datadog_api_key = var.datadog_api_key
  datadog_app_key = var.datadog_app_key
  gcp_secret_id   = module.gcp_integration.secret_id
  gcp_project_id  = var.gcp_project_id
  aws_secret_id   = module.aws_integration.secret_id
  github_token    = var.github_token
  slack_bot_token = var.slack_bot_token
  slack_rca_channel = "#sre-rca"
}

modules.name: Grafana SRE
modules.desc: Self-contained Grafana SRE with 8 runbooks following Google SRE and DORA practices. Creates its own integration.

modules.name: Predictive SRE
modules.desc: Cross-domain predictive triage: correlates GitHub, Grafana, and AWS signals to predict failures before they happen.

modules.name: Repo to IaC
modules.desc: GitHub→IaC workflow plus repo-scan→appStack→export-to-GitHub. Includes stackgen-mcp-consumer-tool-catalog-sop (StackGen user MCP: AppStacks, TF blocks, env profiles, action runs, snapshots, violations). Guild `sg_evidence_checklist` proof-of-work on each workflow.

modules.name: Software Engineering
modules.desc: Linear + Cursor + GitHub development pipeline: analyze tickets, author code, submit PRs. 2 agents. Guild `sg_evidence_checklist` proof-of-work on the feature-development workflow.

modules.name: SDLC
modules.desc: Nine agents, release pipeline, developer request intake; stackgen-mcp-iac aligned with StackGen user MCP (AppStacks, plans, snapshots). Optionally attach stackgen-mcp-consumer-tool-catalog-sop from repo-to-iac. Guild `sg_evidence_checklist` on developer intake; optional SRE checklist name for the release pipeline.

modules.name: Supply Chain Security
modules.desc: npm supply chain detection plus CCE CVE reachability: prioritize fix PRs for reachable call sites only.

modules.name: Compliance Auditor
modules.desc: Automated compliance auditing plus optional compliance-evidence-factory workflow: multi-repo CCE pack scan (audit-evidence, regulatory-scope, landing-zone-governance) with aggregated digest.

modules.name: Cost Optimizer
modules.desc: FinOps agent for multi-cloud cost optimization: idle resources, rightsizing, commitment optimization, anomaly detection. 4 runbooks, 1 Guild `sg_evidence_checklist`, 1 workflow.

modules.name: Marketing Operations
modules.desc: AI-powered marketing: content pipeline, campaign analytics, social media monitoring, SEO auditing, email automation. 4 agents.

modules.name: Developer Onboarding
modules.desc: Automated developer onboarding: environment setup, access provisioning, and codebase orientation.

modules.name: Workspace Assistant
modules.desc: Google Workspace + Slack + Linear triage agent for daily developer workflows and ticket management.

modules.name: Ubuntu CLI Inspector
modules.desc: Linux OS diagnostic agent: network connectivity, process analysis, disk space, and log analysis. 4 runbooks.

modules.name: ClickHouse Inspector
modules.desc: Deep ClickHouse diagnostics: cluster health, slow queries, parts/merge analysis, memory pressure, ingestion throughput. 5 runbooks.

modules.name: DB Optimizer
modules.desc: DBRE-style agent for slow-query analysis, EXPLAIN plans, and indexing recommendations. Optional Datadog and Slack integrations.

modules.name: IaC Drift Detective
modules.desc: CloudOps agent for Terraform/OpenTofu drift vs live AWS/GCP; scan, analyze, and open PRs to reconcile IaC.

modules.name: Langfuse AI Quality Observer
modules.desc: Langfuse-first AI ops scorecard with optional Grafana, Slack, GitHub, and other integrations for cross-domain correlation.

modules.name: Agent Schedules
modules.desc: Composable sg_agent_schedule resources: cron prompts for any agent or workflow (same target_type / target_name pairing as sg_webhook).

modules.name: SOC Analyst
modules.desc: Tier-1 SOC agent: automated alert triage and proactive threat-hunting workflows with security-tool integrations.

modules.name: StackGen MCP + Guardrails
modules.desc: StackGen MCP Guild integration (Vault Other/mcp) plus read-only OPA guardrails. stackgen-audit runbook documents read-only user-MCP tools (get_appstacks, get_appstack_resources, get_action_run_logs, get_current_violations, …).

modules.name: SRE Incident Commander
modules.desc: Major-incident orchestration across PagerDuty, Slack, and Datadog: acknowledge, diagnose, mitigate, postmortem draft.

modules.name: Terraform Module Bot
modules.desc: GitHub webhook-driven module workflow plus optional pre-deploy-iam-review PR workflow: CCE entitlement delta with file:line GitHub comments.

modules.name: AWS CDK Bot
modules.desc: GitHub webhook-driven AWS CDK workflow: six-check validate (lint, typecheck, synth, cfn-lint, tests, cdk-nag) before draft PR; optional catalog repo profile and AWS validation.

modules.name: DB / monorepo state split
modules.desc: Multi-cloud Terraform/OpenTofu monolith state → logical groups (tags, modules, grouping_policy_json); optional per-group TF roots; StackGen AppStacks via optional stackgen_mcp_integration_name; count + plan convergence; secondary orphan-iac-module-authoring workflow. Persona/runbooks: /tmp preflight, runbook-first + redacted notes, bounded shell/MCP caching, remote-runner caveats; CI smoke-renders orchestration tftpl. Guild `sg_evidence_checklist` proof-of-work on both workflows.

modules.name: Monorepo services split
modules.desc: Application monolith → microservices in two Guild workflows: analysis (clone, boundary scan, CCE critical-path scans, DDD synthesis, guidance PR with service-catalog.yaml + AGENTS.md) then extract (plan gate, scaffold services/<name>/, optional Cursor, extract PR). Go/JS/TS/Java; script pack + CCE pack baked into Ubuntu sidecar at apply; optional aiden-runner; unit-test confidence gates; PR-only to same repo. See docs/monorepo-services-splitter.md.

modules.name: Resource Janitor
modules.desc: Multi-cloud unused-resource detection (≥30 days inactive — Lambda invocations, S3 last-modified, idle compute / disks / public IPs across AWS, Azure, GCP) plus a HITL-gated tag-and-quarantine cleanup workflow with dwell window, blast-radius caps, `dangerous_ops` policy, and an evidence checklist on the destructive workflow.

modules.name: Pipeline Insights
modules.desc: Read-only GitHub pipeline & deployment intelligence: workflow run status, PR merge metadata (who / when / mode / reviewers), deployment statuses with failure log excerpts. Optional Slack ingress `sg_webhook` so a Slack bridge can fire the workflow with a raw question.

modules.name: SLO Health
modules.desc: OpenSLO + Grafana SLO health: weekly error-budget review with config drift vs alerts/dashboards; bootstrap workflow discovers SLOs from Grafana and opens OpenSLO PR; drift-reconcile workflow patches Git via PR. Monday schedule on slo-health-review.

modules.name: Release Tracker
modules.desc: Read-only microservice release tracker: latest GitHub tags + Releases, GHCR image-tag enumeration, deployed-version correlation across environments, ref-to-ref release diffs. Optional service catalog so operators can ask "what's the latest version of X?" without naming the repo.

modules.name: Scenario Author
modules.desc: Closes the SE feedback loop: triages `scenario-request` GitHub issues, matches existing scenarios, and delegates new `examples/scenarios/<slug>/` scaffolding (5 files + `scripts/demo.sh` entry + `docs/se-playbook.md` row + `tofu validate` + auto-PR via Cursor's GitHub App) to a Cursor Cloud Agent via `cursor_agents_run_task`, then comments back on the issue via `gh issue comment`. Uses GitHub + Cursor integrations (no Ubuntu CLI shell scripting). Strict repo + label gate; optional `sg_webhook` ingress for GitHub `issue` events.
